messages:
alex: Quick huddle on lightweight autofallback operator flow. Goal: minimal friction in inbox + clear audit trail. We need a small "why" card, an inspect path, and a low-friction retry/override that surfaces quota impact.

maria: Love it. Requirements: 1) short human-friendly reason (not just code), 2) the rule name that matched, 3) suggested next steps (retry, pin, escalate), 4) RBAC gating for overrides.

sam: Ops data ask: include a tiny telemetry snapshot (latency P50/P95, error class, recent success ratio) and a link to trace + sample tokens (redacted). Don't show full request.

ops-bot: (infra) Policy rollout v2.3 -> 15% of routes. Canary is live.

alex: UI sketch idea: collapsed card showing: title line "Fallback: latency_threshold (rule: autoswitch-5m)", second line telemetry icons, third line actions (retry / open / pin). Expand opens side panel with trace + sampling details.

jon: Action button UX: "Retry" should show a small modal with estimated quota cost (tokens + model delta) before confirmation and async toast after submit. Also show whether retry will hit the same route or bypass to fallback variant.

maria: Telemetry labels to add: fallback.trigger, fallback.rule, fallback.confidence, fallback.reason_text. Also add sample_rate label so we can know if trace captured full payload.

sam: Sampling proposal: deterministic sample by route hash (1% default), with upweighting for routes that have >0.5% fallback rate over a 10m window. Also: operator inspect should flip sampling to 100% for that request id for up to 5 minutes to allow replay.

alex: API design question: do we reuse rollout endpoints for operator ack/inspect or create dedicated operator endpoints?

todd: Prefer dedicated endpoints: /operator/ack and /operator/inspect. Keeps semantics clear and easier to audit events separately from config changes.

maria: RBAC: override requires scope ops:override and should create an immutable audit entry with operator id, timestamp, original request id, and the action taken. No silent overrides.

sam: I'll prototype the sampling hook that listens for an inspect call and tags the stream. CLI flag to force full capture for QA is helpful for testing.

jon: Small accessibility note: action icons need labels for screen readers. Also keyboard nav for quick triage.

alex: Edge-case: if the fallback reason includes model error with PII in token sample, we should show a short "we redacted payload for privacy" blurb and a reason code so auditors know why content was removed. Maria to add wording.

maria: Suggested blurb: "Payload redacted by default to protect user privacy. Operators can request a replay for approved audits; replay includes an access log entry."

todd: Todd -> draft /operator/{ack,inspect} openapi spec and example payloads.

maria: Maria -> trace schema updates (labels) and small privacy blurb text.

sam: Sam -> sampling hook PoC and CLI QA flag.

jon: Jon -> quick Figma mock for the collapsed card + side panel. Keep it to one screen so designers can iterate quickly.

alex: I'll open a tiny RFC PR with wireframes + API sketch and assign tasks. Sync next Tue 9:30am. If no objections, proceed. :thumbsup:
notes: compact thread about operator inbox UX, telemetry labels, sampling behaviour, dedicated operator endpoints, RBAC and privacy blurb
